safe.label: Money buys the whole party and still not one real love
safe.note: The chorus states it plainly: everything is available except the one thing being searched for.

safe.label: The maid comes around too much, the parents not enough
safe.note: A house full of staff and no family. Care is outsourced and salaried.

real.label: I pay for everything so nobody has a reason to leave early
real.note: Buying the night is cheaper than finding out who would stay without it. Fake friends are safer than the answer.

safe.label: Rich kid is a role, and I am playing it well
safe.note: Boredom and excess performed as a personality because the part comes with a script.

real.label: Without the money there is no story anyone would sit through
real.note: The help do not stop to say hi because there is nothing to say hi to. Strip the house and the character disappears.

safe.label: Days spent numb on bottles and joints nobody counts
safe.note: Consumption as a schedule. Nothing to be sober for, so why be sober.

real.label: I stay high because the afternoons in this house are unbearably quiet
real.note: The drugs are not decadence, they are noise. The outro on the roof is what the quiet leads to.

safe.label: Status inherited, never earned, so it proves nothing about me
safe.note: The wealth is the father's. The kid is a passenger in it.

links.source: Money buys the whole party and still not one real love
links.target: I pay for everything so nobody has a reason to leave early
links.rationale: Deepens the generic search for real love into the specific tactic that prevents finding it: the narrator underwrites the friendship so it can never be tested.

links.source: Status inherited, never earned, so it proves nothing about me
links.target: Without the money there is no story anyone would sit through
links.rationale: Moves from unearned status to what that costs the self. The SAFE line is about the money's origin; the REAL one is that the narrator has no identity outside it, so it lands in IDENTITY.

links.source: Days spent numb on bottles and joints nobody counts
links.target: I stay high because the afternoons in this house are unbearably quiet
links.rationale: Names what the intoxication is actually for. Not appetite but the silence of an empty house, which the narrator will not sit in sober.
